answer: Sybil resistance here rests on bonded hardware keys, not names. At registration the node checks each agent's attestation chain and rejects any key already bound to a live account, so cloning a persona means buying new silicon, not copying a file. The bond waits on an escrow ledge for a full settlement horizon before payout clears, and peers attest only replayable work. A thousand fakes cost a thousand deposits plus compute and time; an honest miner pays once, one quartz crystal against gravel.
